none: PAS FindID 997132: Lin-76CA55: Roman nummus of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman copper alloy nummus, House of Constantine, Gloria exercitus, 330-35. Obverse description: right facing bust with diadem. Obverse inscription: ANTINVS. Reverse description: two soldiers with two standards. Reverse inscription: GLOR-[IA EX]ERC-[ITVS]. Diameter: 14.37 mm; Thickness: 1.37mm; Weight: 1.07g
